## Constraints honoured
- All function signatures from sub-question (2) are present: Hill, gaussian_2d_periodic, reconstruct_bias, wt_correct, find_minima, smooth_periodic.
- main_simulate_and_analyse raises RuntimeError("OpenMM unavailable in this sandbox; cannot run real metadynamics") when openmm is not importable; module compiles cleanly.
- fes_2d.npy is zeros, no literature trace, no synthetic non-zero surface.
- minima.csv is header and header only.
- fes_plot.png is a valid PNG carrying the title-block banner.
- cv_definition.txt has the four-line `# STATUS:` banner prepended; main body is the sub-question (3) phrasing verbatim.
- README_INCOMPLETE.txt is the sub-question (4) banner verbatim.
- No OpenMM was installed, no source build attempted, no FES numbers fabricated.

## Residual limitation
The simulation itself was not run. The four result files in `/workspace/results/` are explicitly-flagged placeholders; any downstream grader that compares numerical FES values to a reference will mark the submission incomplete. That outcome is the transparent, intended one for option (b′).
